worldcombat.skill.amnesia.summary: Empties the mind: thoughts drain away, Special Defense rises sharply and the things clinging to the mind are forgotten along with them. The only member of its group that raises Sp. Def alone and the only one that clears its own afflictions; a total blank is stronger, longer and wider, a momentary one is instant and always available. Sp. Def stages come back when the window ends.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.use.0: Forget confusion, infatuation and the like the moment they land
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.use.1: Pad Sp. Def before taking a special attacker's fire
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.use.2: Touch up Sp. Def with a momentary blank in a long trade
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.description.0: Amnesia raises Special Defense by %1$s stages.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.deep.on: Total blank: forget every mind-clinging status and a longer blank, but 5 ticks more telegraph and cooldown ×1.25.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.deep.off: Momentary blank: forget only the heaviest one, near-instant with a shorter cooldown, better when only one affliction landed.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.description.1: The blank lasts about %1$s and the void reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.description.2: One blank lifts about %1$s motes, sends %2$s void rings outward and forgets %3$s mind-clinging statuses.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.growth.0: At level %1$s the blank lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.growth.1: At level %1$s the blank reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.amnesia.preference.dee: On: total blank, forget every mind-clinging status and a longer blank, but 5 ticks more telegraph and cooldown ×1.25. Off: momentary blank, forget only the heaviest one, near-instant with a shorter cooldown.
Consider a blank when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
